name: Pink Loading Spinner
description: A loading spinner template in a soft pink tone. Good for consumer-facing apps and pastel-toned UI demos where even the loading state should feel on-brand.

name: Progress Donut
description: An animated donut chart template that fills around its ring to show progress. Good for dashboard UI demos and metric visualization content.

name: Progress Pie
description: An animated pie chart template that fills to show percentage progress. Good for goal-tracking UI demos and data visualization presentations.

name: Push Notifications: List [iOS]
description: A template showing a list of iOS push notifications appearing in sequence just as they would on a real device. Great for showcasing a notification system in an app demo.

name: Revenue App [Dribbble]
description: An animated revenue app UI template with a polished design aesthetic. Good for fintech app showcases and data dashboard presentations.

name: Simple Notification [iOS]
description: An iOS notification animation template with a realistic slide-in motion. Perfect for app demos and UI presentations where the notification needs to feel like it came straight from the system.

name: Social Media Icons
description: An animated social media icon template where icons reveal in a coordinated sequence. Good for end cards and follow CTAs in video content.

name: Splitting Cube: Perfect Loop
description: A template where a cube splits apart and reassembles in a seamless loop. Good for abstract motion graphics and geometric animation showcases.

name: The Prompt: AI Chat
description: An animated AI chat interface template with message-by-message reveals. Great for conversational AI product demos and chatbot feature presentations.

name: The Prompt: Image Generation
description: An animated UI template showing an AI image generation interface. Great for showcasing AI product features and generative tool demos where showing the experience is more convincing than describing it.

name: The Vault: App Icons
description: An animated template showing multiple app icons appearing in a grid. Works well for app family presentations and product ecosystem showcases.

name: The Vault: Contactless Payment
description: An animated template showing a contactless payment tap interaction. Perfect for fintech product demos and banking app showcases where you want the experience to feel smooth.

name: The Vault: Digital Wallet
description: An animated digital wallet UI template showing card management and balance screens. Great for banking and fintech app demos that need to feel considered and credible.

name: The Vault: Payment Notification
description: An animated payment notification template with clean fintech-style UI. Ideal for banking app demos and payment confirmation flow showcases.

name: The Vault: Payment Notifications
description: An animated template showing multiple payment notifications arriving in a stacked sequence. Good for fintech app UI demos and payment system showcases.

name: Yosemite: Animated Widget
description: An animated widget template from Fons Mans with a macOS-inspired design. Great for desktop app UI showcases and macOS product presentations.
